card.name: Start of 1-800 numbers and section refs
card.fires_on: The digit 1 starting the FDA or poison-control phone number 1-800, and the opening parenthesis before a section number after 'Warnings and Precautions' or 'see ... Information'. Also fires on a few other scattered spots.

modes.label: Phone number start
modes.description: The leading 1 of a toll-free number such as 1-800-FDA-1088 in adverse-event reporting text.
modes.example: You may report side effects to FDA at <<1>>-800-FDA-1

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: The opening parenthesis before a numbered label section reference in brackets.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a toll-free phone number or a label section number is about to begin.
